newsitem.title: USA: Sears in marketing partnership with Women's NBA.
newsitem.headline: Sears in marketing partnership with Women's NBA.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co., seeking to expand its female customer base, said Wednesday it signed a multi-year marketing partnership with the WNBA, the new women's professional basketball league being formed by the National Basketball Association.
"We are continually looking for ways to connect with our female customer," John Costello, Sears senior executive vice president of marketing, said in a statement.

Sears said its WNBA deal includes advertising during regular season and playoff games, advertising in WNBA publications, national and local promotional rights to the WNBA logo and WNBA team names and logos, courtside signs, and player appearances and other in-store promotions.
The company also said the deal will allow it to sell WNBA licensed apparel and non-apparel products, and conduct in-store promotions in Sears stores in the eight WNBA markets.
Sears said the WNBA partnership is a contination of its support for women's sports, including the women's national team that won the gold medal at the 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta.
